capabilities.title: Codex Activity Oversight
capabilities.description: Bind an explicitly activated coding objective to deterministic .CAO state while Native Codex exclusively owns official subagent execution topology.

runtimeBinding.instruction: Activate only from an explicit CAO request or explicit active-workflow continuation. Bind .CAO to the exact root thread, use official Hooks for immediate root and descendant events, use official app-server readback for typed reconciliation receipts, and expose incomplete lifecycle observations without inferring semantic completion. Bind passed verification to the exact active contract IDs it covers and finalize into a completed handoff. Never launch workers, select models, prescribe topology, flatten descendants, or infer semantic completion from runtime completion.

authorityRequests.reason: CAO is opt-in and must not bind state from directory presence alone.
CAO writes deterministic untracked state under the selected jobsite .CAO directory.
Official Hook payloads and app-server readback establish exact session-tree and collaboration facts.
